tips.label: Too many at once
tips.text: 7 sessions were active at once at 14:20; together they ate 82% of the day, about $79.00
tips.who: Refactor auth middleware, Add billing webhooks, Fix flaky e2e tests, Migrate to Postgres 16
tips.tip:
Run fewer sessions at once.
This is the busiest stretch of the day. Each extra session adds context that has to be rebuilt.

tips.label: Cold cache
tips.text: 5 requests rebuilt over 50K tokens of cache, about $8.40 of extra work
tips.who: Tune cache headers, Refresh design tokens
tips.tip:
Keep related turns together.
A gap over five minutes lets the prompt cache go cold, so the next request pays to rebuild it.

tips.label: Heavy context
tips.text: One session carried 857K tokens of context, about $18.70
tips.tip:
Start a fresh thread for a new task.
A long context raises the cost of every later request in that session.
